caption: The drawing depicts a carved female figure, possibly made of wood, positioned upright and shown from the knees upward. The figure wears a light blue short-sleeved bodice with a ruffled edge at the waist and an elaborate, multi-layered white or grey skirt featuring swirling patterns. She is adorned with several pieces of jewelry: a tiara or headdress, a necklace with large beads and a pendant, bracelets on each wrist, and possibly a brooch on her upper garment. Her skin tone is brown, and her long hair is styled back behind her shoulders. Her right arm is bent with her hand near her chest, while her left hand is resting at her side. The base of the sculpture, visible at the bottom, is painted or carved to resemble green and black flowing shapes, suggesting a stylized foundation. The background of the image is plain and off-white. The overall colors are muted blues, greys, browns, and greens, and the drawing is rendered in a realistic style with attention to shadows and highlights.
title: Figurehead
